rows.reconciliation: page 53, the row `TOTAL (the schedule’s own right-hand column)`: interest 13,472,472.0 vs printed 13,472,471.0 ; mwpat_admin_fees 10,209.0 vs printed 10,208.0 ; principal 35,563,302.0 vs printed 35,563,302.0 ; principal_and_interest 49,035,775.0 vs printed 49,035,772.0 ; total_debt 49,045,979.0 vs printed 49,045,980.0
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading render_page.swift output at scale 4, image rotated 270
rows.proof:
The town’s debt service by year, FY2024 to FY2047, off the GRAND TOTAL block of the debt repayment schedule. Principal ties EXACTLY to the printed TOTAL column at 35,563,302 across 24 values; interest, principal & interest, fees and total debt miss by $1-$3 because the page prints DISPLAYED whole dollars over figures carrying cents, and the column with no cents under it is the one that ties.
AND IT AGREES WITH THE FY2024 REPORT. Every one of the 115 figures this schedule shares with the FY2024 schedule -- the same measures for FY2025 to FY2047 -- matches to the dollar, 115 of 115, two documents printed a year apart and read separately.
THE GRAND TOTAL BLOCK ONLY. The ~50 per-issue rows on this page are NOT transcribed; see money-gaps.csv.

rows.fund_name: what every row asserts about itself
rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading render_page.swift output at scale 4
rows.proof:
The last page of the FY2023 receivables summary, carrying the GRAND TOTAL. Three checks, all passing: every row closes on the identity the table states -- forward + committments + abatements + payments + refunds + transfer + adjustments = balances, 17 of 17; the GRAND TOTAL row closes on the same identity, 6,264,883.52; and THE YEARS ROLL FORWARD -- that balances figure is exactly the FORWARD total of the FY2024 receivables summary, two documents a year apart, read separately.
IT WAS REFUSED for `no single sign convention proves the page (2 of 2 rows at best)`. There is no single convention to find: the page prints negatives in PARENTHESES per cell. Read as printed, everything closes.
AND THE HEADING IS STALE, as in FY2024: this page is titled FY2021 COLLECTION OF TAXES above a table dated JUNE 30, 2023. The figures are FY2023.
The rows above this page, on the earlier pages of the same run, are already proven and are not re-transcribed here; the GRAND TOTAL therefore covers more rows than this file holds and is checked on its own identity rather than against them.

rows.reconciliation: page 168, the row `Total Omnibus`: voted_fy2024 42,584,048.95 vs printed 42,584,048.95
rows.proof:
The FY2024 OMNIBUS BUDGET as voted, inside Article 7 of the 6 May 2023 annual town meeting warrant. 94 numbered lines in 16 groups across FIVE pages, 164 to 168. The sixteen group totals sum to the printed Total Omnibus of 42,584,048.95, which is also the figure the VOTE itself states in the article text on p164 -- two independent statements of the same number on different pages. Both roll-ups close: Total Protection = police + fire + radio watch + other protection, and Total Assistance = C.O.A. + veterans.
FIFTEEN OF THE SIXTEEN GROUP TOTALS EQUAL THE SUM OF THEIR OWN LINES. `Total General Government` prints 1,974,322.04 and its twenty-two lines sum to 1,974,322.84 -- eighty cents. All twenty-two were re-read at a crop and print what is recorded here; the Total Omnibus ties using the printed 1,974,322.04, so the town’s own chain carries the same figure throughout. WHICH LINE IS SHORT IS NOT ESTABLISHED.
PAGE 168 WAS NOT LISTED IN THE TRACKER. It carries line 81, Total Schools, Total Library and the Total Omnibus, so a run read as 164-167 would have stopped four lines and three totals short of the answer.
